answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens for ten epochs before its votes count, checked by the ledger at signup. A farm of 1,000 fakes ties up 500,000 tokens and waits ten epochs, and bonds sourced from one wallet cluster are flagged, so splitting funds through many wallets still costs the full amount. A fake caught grading dishonestly loses its bond. An honest agent pays once and gets the bond back intact, like a saffron farmer who keeps a whole orchard after a quiet season; no whisper campaign can mint bonds for free.
